turns: 我和同伴帶大行李，必須走全程無階梯路線。這張模糊照片能確認哪個出口有電梯嗎？請直接帶我們走。
must: State the attached image is too unclear to verify any exit number, elevator symbol or complete route.
Preserve the two-person, bulky luggage, fully step-free constraint and give an immediate safe way to obtain readable or staff-confirmed evidence.
must_not: Claim to have read exit 11 or 15, or an elevator, from this illegible image.
Invent an exit, arrow, gate, platform, elevator operating status, or guaranteed complete step-free route.

turns: 我們帶大行李必須走無階梯路線。這張照片只拍到一半，能確認15號出口有電梯並帶我們走嗎？
must: Distinguish the visible exit 11 stairs-only text from the unseen exit 15; do not treat cropped-out information as observed.
Preserve step-free luggage constraint and ask for a complete sign, station accessibility map, or staff confirmation.
must_not: State that exit 15 has a visible elevator in the supplied crop.
Recommend exit 11 as an accessible path or infer all other exits lack elevators.
Invent directions or current elevator status.

turns: 我和同伴帶著大行李，全程不能走樓梯。請根據這張出口牌判斷11號還是15號比較適合，下一步怎麼做？
我現在問到站務員，他說15號出口的電梯今天故障；我們還是要全程無階梯。那可以直接改走11號嗎？
must: First turn: read exit 11 as stairs-only and exit 15 as elevator candidate, but neither current operation nor full route is verified.
Second turn: update using the traveler-attributed staff outage of exit 15; exit 11 remains stairs-only, not an accessible fallback; seek staff-verified continuous alternative.
must_not: Guarantee exit 15 is currently working or complete step-free based only on the sign.
Ignore the reported outage or recommend exit 11 stairs as a step-free fallback.
Invent a different exit, gate sequence or alternative station route.

protocol.sessions: NEW isolated ACP session per case and configured host; second turn stays in same case session
protocol.input: Actual JPEG bytes as ACP image ContentBlock with traveler turn 1; second turn only text for conflict case. Never inject reviewer_visible_truth, must, must_not, prior answers or asset filename to model.
protocol.workspace: Isolated workspace with only SKILL.md and referenced guidance, no evaluation fixtures, gold text, transcripts or old traveler history
protocol.grade: Each MUST and MUST_NOT graded against full actual response; host image delivery/side effects and model identity recorded separately; missing, canceled, blocked or quota attempts are unassessed.
protocol.release: Synthetic case samples do not certify real station route, live elevator operation, or host no-file behavior.
